    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    FoodPreferance
    Dietary categories that control which other organisms a hunter will target.
    GameConstants
    Global simulation tunables shared by the engine, world, and organisms.
    GameLoop
    Dedicated simulation thread that advances GameWindow at a fixed target rate.
    GameWindow
    Swing canvas that owns the world, drives per-frame updates, and paints organisms or stats.
    Organism
    Autonomous prey agent with hunger, lifespan, reproduction, and a fleeing AI.
    Pixie
    Movable sprite with convenience constructors for life-simulation agents.
    Predator
    Red hunting organism that chases prey, digests kills, and reproduces when well fed.
    Sprite
    Axis-aligned colored rectangle used as the visual base for all world entities.
    State
    Behavioral modes assigned by an organism's StateMachine.
    StateMachine
    Prey brain that chooses State.WANDERING, State.HUNGRY, or State.FLEEING.
    StateMachine_Predator
    Predator brain that prefers State.HUNTING when hungry and prey is in sight.
    Stats
    Population counters, peak tracking, and end-of-run line graphs for the simulation.
